sentences.text:
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.4211 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/A1 to A4 under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.115 of 2020 on the file of Nagarjunasagar Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 420 and 328 read with 34 IPC, Sections 57(1), 58 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch dated 18.12.2019.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this Criminal Petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.

The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch dated 18.12.2019 to this order.
_______________________________ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date:
30.09.2020 Pab THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION NO.4222 OF 2020 Date: 30.09.2020 Pab Pulla Rao Gade vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 30 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73596025/
